themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Surge
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints skyrocketed to 5 in the last week versus a near-zero 0.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 3900% spike with z-score 14.74—suggesting either rapid unlicensed retail expansion or a sudden enforcement crackdown worth investigating this week.
evidence: 5 cannabis retailer complaints this week vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 14.74 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
3900% increase represents most severe spike in entire dataset
reporting_angles: Are unlicensed cannabis retailers proliferating in Borough Park/Kensington, and what enforcement response exists?
Track licensing data: how many legal vs. illegal retailers are operating, and where are complaints clustering geographically?

themes_detail.label: Abandoned Bikes Piling Up
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned bike complaints jumped to 5 this week from a baseline of 0.8 per week—a 567% spike with z-score 6.43—suggesting either a dockless bike abandonment problem or a new enforcement initiative worth documenting.
evidence: 5 abandoned bike complaints this week vs. 0.8 weekly baseline over 8 weeks
Z-score of 6.43 indicates statistically significant spike
567% increase concentrated in single reporting week
reporting_angles: Are dockless bike operators (Citi Bike, alternatives) failing to retrieve abandoned units in the district?
Is Parks Dept or Sanitation conducting a targeted removal operation that triggered complaint volume?

themes_detail.label: Street Signs Missing Citywide?
themes_detail.summary: Missing street sign complaints surged to 5 this week from a 1.0 weekly average—a 400% spike with z-score 5.66—indicating either systematic sign theft, vandalism, or deferred maintenance affecting navigation and safety this week.
evidence: 5 missing street sign complaints this week vs. 1.0 weekly baseline
Z-score of 5.66 indicates highly significant anomaly
400% spike concentrated in this week's reporting
reporting_angles: Document where signs are missing (major intersections, school zones, transit hubs) and photograph the gaps
Interview DOT about response time and whether this reflects budget cuts or a localized theft/vandalism pattern

themes_detail.label: Encampment Expansion
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints rose to 3 last week from a 0.5 weekly average—a 500% spike with z-score 3.54—signaling possible homelessness concentration or new unsanctioned settlements in Borough Park/Kensington requiring urgent outreach investigation.
evidence: 3 encampment complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average over 8 weeks
Z-score of 3.54 indicates statistically significant cluster
500% spike suggests rapid emergence rather than chronic baseline
reporting_angles: Map encampment locations and interview residents and outreach workers about triggers (service closures, seasonal migration, housing cost spikes)
Contact HPD and Department of Homeless Services about whether funding or shelter capacity has changed

themes_detail.label: Overgrown Trees & Branches
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints reached 6 this week from a 1.6 weekly baseline—a 269% spike with z-score 3.59—suggesting deferred Parks maintenance or storm damage this week that threatens pedestrian safety.
evidence: 6 overgrown tree complaints this week vs. 1.6 weekly baseline
reporting_angles: Verify whether recent weather (wind, rain) caused branch falls or whether Parks has deferred trimming schedules
Cross-reference with Parks Dept work orders to assess response capacity and backlog
